LanguageData.FE_SettingsIntroduction: These settings apply to every save. Existing family records are kept.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsFertilityCycleTip: Enable FE fertility cycles and use FE's fertility age curve for eligible pawns.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsMenopauseTip: Allow new menopause transitions. Existing postmenopausal pawns remain unchanged.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsMultibirthTip: Use FE's twin and triplet chances when a pregnancy's baby count is first set. Existing baby counts are kept.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsGeneCommonalityTip: Chance for a newly generated humanlike pawn to receive the inheritable multiple birth predisposition gene. Male carriers can pass it to their children, but it does not affect their own fertility.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsRecoveryTip: Apply FE's five-day postpartum fertility recovery to future deliveries.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsExhaustionTip: Use FE's exhaustion duration, recovery speed, and movement penalties after future births.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsSadnessTip: Allow postpartum depression after future deliveries.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsProcedureOverridesTip: Use FE's vasectomy, vasectomy-reversal, and tubal-ligation changes for procedures performed after this setting is saved.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsLactationSystemTip: Enable FE milk production, automatic self-milking, and lactation induced by implants or the Wet Nurse role. Turning this off does not remove existing lactation or disable infant feeding and other Wet Nurse role effects.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsBreastScaling: RJW Breast Size Hediff Lactation Scaling
LanguageData.FE_SettingsBreastScalingEnabledTip: When enabled, milk storage and production are multiplied by RimJobWorld breast size, with a multiplier for each size. When disabled, breast size has no effect on milk.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsBreastScalingInfo: Multiplies milk storage and production for each RimJobWorld breast size. With Lactation Expansion, this scales its lactation capacity and lactation per day.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsBreastScalingTierTip: Milk storage and production multiplier for {TIER} breasts.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsMaleLactationGene: Male lactation from the wet nurse gene
LanguageData.FE_SettingsMaleLactationGeneTip: Let male carriers of the wet nurse gene lactate. Not available while Lactation Expansion is active, since it replaces the gene with its own.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsMaleLactationRole: Male lactation from the Wet Nurse role
LanguageData.FE_SettingsMaleLactationRoleTip: Let male pawns holding the Wet Nurse role lactate. When off, the role keeps its other effects for men.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsMaleLactationImplant: Male lactation from the lactation implant
LanguageData.FE_SettingsMaleLactationImplantTip: Let male pawns with a lactation implant lactate.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsAdvancedLactationTip: Adjust milk storage, production speed, and milk type for each xenotype using FE milk production. Other milk mods keep their own settings.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsXenotypeTip: Select the xenotype whose FE-managed lactation values are being edited.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsStorageCapacityTip: Adjust the shared milk capacity for breastfeeding and expression, compared with vanilla nursing capacity.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsProductionRateTip: Adjust how quickly the shared milk supply replenishes, compared with vanilla nursing production.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsProducedMilkTip: Choose the item produced by FE self-milking for this xenotype. If the xenotype's genes set a milk, that is the default. A pawn who carries an active milk gene always produces that gene's milk, whatever is chosen here, so this choice only reaches members of the xenotype without one. This does not change breastfeeding ideology recognition.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsDisableAdoptionTip: Stop new FE emergency adoption requests. Existing requests and family records are kept.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsDisableFosterTip: Stop new FE foster placement requests. Existing foster stays can still be completed.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsBondingTip: Give the birthing parent a bonding memory for each future baby.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsSupportedTip: Allow a positive memory when the birthing parent receives enough care in the first three days after birth. Their postpartum care beliefs affect how much care is needed.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsNeglectedTip: Allow a negative memory for poor care in the first three days after birth. Their postpartum care beliefs affect when neglect is noticed and how severe the penalty is.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsSingleParentTip: Allow a negative memory after birth when neither the birthing parent's partner nor the baby's other biological parent is on the map.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsCoparentTip: Give the birthing parent a positive memory when their partner or the baby's other biological parent is nearby at birth.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsChildHarmTip: Give biological, adoptive, and foster parents memories when their child is harmed.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsAdoptiveWelcomeTip: Allow positive adoption memories for assigned parents. Kinship beliefs can change or prevent the memory; Bloodline primacy's penalty is unaffected.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsFosterWelcomeTip: Give a foster parent a positive memory when they are assigned to a child.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsFosterBondTip: Give a foster child a positive memory when a foster parent is assigned.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsRjwAutoTip: Disable FE reproductive drugs when regular RJW uses its own pregnancy system. Keep them enabled with vanilla pregnancy or Lucius RJW. RJW's drugs are unchanged.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsRjwPreferFeTip: Keep FE reproductive drugs available. RJW's drugs remain unchanged.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsRjwPreferRjwTip: Hide FE reproductive drugs and disable their reproductive effects, including those of existing stock. RJW's drugs remain unchanged.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsFeRecovery: Fertility Expanded: 5 days, 5% of normal fertility
LanguageData.FE_SettingsRecoveryDisabledTip: Enable Postpartum recovery in FE Settings to use this option. While it is disabled, the other mod handles recovery.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsBirthRecoveryFuture: Applies to future births only. Existing recovery conditions are unchanged.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsEggRecoveryFuture: Applies to future egg laying only. Existing recovery conditions are unchanged.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsLactationGrowthTip: Gradually increase Sized Apparel's rendered breast size with Lactating severity, capped at one size tier. RJW anatomy is not changed.
LanguageData.FE_SettingsNoCompatibility: No compatibility choices are available for the currently active mods. Automatic integrations do not add settings.
LanguageData.FE_SelfMilkDescription: Automatically express surplus milk into usable food items, keeping a reserve for nursing.
LanguageData.FE_LactationDisabled: The Fertility Expanded lactation system is disabled in settings.
LanguageData.FE_ExternalMilkProduction: Milk production is handled by another active milk mod.
LanguageData.FE_NotEnoughMilk: Not enough milk above the nursing reserve.
LanguageData.FE_SelfMilkStoredDescription:
Automatically express milk as {MILK} when full, or while idle with at least one unit above the nursing reserve. The pawn will use a nearby chair when available.

Shared milk: {STORED}/{CAPACITY} nutrition.
Reserved for nursing: {RESERVE} nutrition.
LanguageData.FE_TubalLigationDescription: A somewhat invasive surgery to render the patient unable to reproduce.
LanguageData.FE_VasectomyDescription: A minor surgery to render the patient unable to reproduce.
LanguageData.FE_VasectomyHediffDescription: The pawn is unable to reproduce. This can be surgically reversed, though reversal becomes less reliable with age.
LanguageData.FE_ReverseVasectomyDescription: Attempt to reverse the vasectomy and make the patient capable of reproduction. Reversal becomes less reliable with biological age.
LanguageData.FE_ReverseVasectomyFailed: {SURGEON_labelShort} could not reverse {PATIENT_labelShort}'s vasectomy. It can be attempted again.
LanguageData.FE_CycleFertilityFactor: Fertility: {FACTOR}% of normal during this phase.
LanguageData.FE_FertilityEffectsFactor: Fertility Expanded fertility effects: {FACTOR} of normal
LanguageData.FE_RjwInactiveStatus: RJW is not active; Fertility Expanded drugs are available.
LanguageData.FE_RjwDrugsDisabledStatus: Fertility Expanded fertility drugs are hidden and inert for this session.
LanguageData.FE_RjwDrugsEnabledStatus: Fertility Expanded fertility drugs are available for this session.
LanguageData.FE_RjwOwnershipPending: {STATUS} Restart RimWorld to apply the current settings.

LanguageData.FE_OrphanInvalidPawn: selected pawn is missing, destroyed, or dead.
LanguageData.FE_OrphanNotHumanlike: selected pawn is not a humanlike pawn with relations.
LanguageData.FE_OrphanNotColonist: selected pawn is not a free colonist.
LanguageData.FE_OrphanNotChild: selected pawn is not a baby or child.
LanguageData.FE_OrphanFosterPlacement: selected pawn is part of a foster placement.
LanguageData.FE_OrphanHasParent: selected pawn still has a living recognized parent.
LanguageData.FE_DevBirthCount: Fertility Expanded: planned baby count for {PAWN_labelShort}: {COUNT}.
LanguageData.FE_DevNotFoster: Fertility Expanded: selected pawn is not part of an active foster placement.
LanguageData.FE_DevFosterReviewSent: Fertility Expanded: foster review letter sent.
LanguageData.FE_DevFosterReviewFailed: Fertility Expanded: foster review could not be sent.
LanguageData.FE_DevActiveFoster: Fertility Expanded: selected pawn is part of an active foster placement.
LanguageData.FE_DevOrphanReviewSent: Fertility Expanded: orphan adoption review letter sent.
LanguageData.FE_DevSelectPregnant: Fertility Expanded: select a pregnant or laboring pawn.
LanguageData.FE_DevFosterRequestSent: Fertility Expanded: foster placement request sent.
LanguageData.FE_DevAdoptionRequestSent: Fertility Expanded: emergency adoption request sent.
